Container.Name: camera-import
Container.Overview: Insert a camera card – new photos and videos land in Immich automatically. Reports via Telegram, asks for the album, stacks RAW+HIF/JPG pairs and remembers what was already imported. Needs Unassigned Devices with Automount and Read Only for the card reader or camera.

Config.Name: Cards (Unassigned Devices)
Config.Description: Where Unassigned Devices mounts the card. Read-only – do not change.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Memory (what was already imported), log, last import

Config.Name: Backup folder
Config.Description: Optional: where /backup on copies the card, e.g. /mnt/user/camera-backup/ (one folder per day). Empty = no backup.

Config.Name: Immich API key
Config.Description: Immich → Account Settings → API Keys (permissions: see README, or “All”)

Config.Name: Album
Config.Description: ask = bot asks | date = “Import YYYY-MM-DD” | fixed = album name below | none = no album

Config.Name: Dry run
Config.Description: 1 = upload nothing, only report what would happen

Config.Name: Unmount afterwards
Config.Description: 1 = unmount the card after the import and after /cancel. Needs the User Script camera-import-helper (see README).

Config.Name: Album question timeout (s)
Config.Description: How long the bot waits for your reply

Config.Name: Progress messages (%)
Config.Description: The bot reports at these percentages, empty = never

Config.Name: Stack cover
Config.Description: display = HIF/JPG on top, raw = RAW on top

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the container runs as (99 = nobody)
